title: carex stenophylla var. duriuscula

This plant is used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their specific health benefits, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments.
